ChkBloat: Remove bloatware / AI apps (keeps Store, Xbox, Edge/WebView2, runtimes)
ChkSearch: Force 100% local search (disable Bing/Edge web search)
ChkVisual: Apply custom performance visual effects profile
ChkPrivacy: Block telemetry, WER, CEIP, Activity Feed, Location (Group Policy)
ChkDrivers: Block automatic driver installation via Windows Update
ChkPagefile: Set optimized pagefile size (Min/Max based on installed RAM)
TxtSafeModeNetTitle: Restart to Safe Mode with Networking
TxtSafeModeNetDesc: Restarts Windows into Safe Mode with Networking (minimal drivers/services, but with network access), useful for troubleshooting, removing stubborn malware, or uninstalling problematic drivers. Windows will keep booting into Safe Mode until you turn it off again via System Configuration (msconfig) or a normal 'bootcfg' reset - a reminder is shown before restarting.
TxtUefiRestartDesc: Restarts directly into your motherboard's UEFI/BIOS setup screen, skipping the usual 'press DEL/F2' step. Requires a UEFI system (not legacy BIOS); if your PC doesn't support it, Windows will show an error and no change is made.
TxtNormalRestartDesc: Clears any pending Safe Mode boot flag and restarts Windows normally. Use this after you're done troubleshooting in Safe Mode, instead of going through System Configuration (msconfig) manually.
TxtDiskCleanupDesc: Opens the built-in Windows Disk Cleanup tool (cleanmgr), which lets you remove temporary files, old Windows Update files, Recycle Bin contents and more through a simple checklist.
TxtRamCleanDesc: Instantly clears the Standby List memory cache (the same native, safe action available in the Optimizations tab), reclaiming RAM held by closed apps without restarting anything.
TxtResourceMonitorDesc: Opens the built-in Windows Resource Monitor (resmon), a detailed, real-time view of CPU, memory, disk and network usage per process - more advanced than Task Manager.
TxtOptimizeDrivesDesc: Opens the built-in Windows 'Optimize Drives' tool (dfrgui), which defragments HDDs and sends TRIM to SSDs on a schedule you control.
TxtMemDiagDesc: Opens the built-in Windows Memory Diagnostic tool (mdsched), which restarts the PC and runs a thorough RAM hardware test - useful if you suspect faulty memory (random crashes/BSODs).
TxtExtScriptsWarning: These are independent, third-party open-source scripts (not part of WGO). Each one opens in its own window and requests admin rights on its own. Only run tools from sources you trust.
TxtMassgraveDesc: Launches the official Microsoft Activation Scripts (MASSGRAVE) project, a well-known open-source community tool for activating Windows and Microsoft Office via HWID, KMS38 or Online KMS. It opens an interactive text menu in a new console window; just follow the on-screen options to pick the activation method you want.
TxtUniGetUIDesc: A graphical interface for WinGet, Chocolatey, Scoop, Pip, npm and other package managers. The winget/Chocolatey installer can trigger a "publisher could not be verified" warning, so this opens the official download page instead of installing silently.
LogExtScriptLaunched: {0} launched in a new window. Follow the instructions there.
AppFirefoxDesc: Highly recommended browser that does not use the Chromium engine, offering real privacy, more user control and full support for effective ad blockers (like uBlock Origin).
AppNanaZipDesc: Lightweight, modern archiver natively integrated into the new Windows 11 context menu.
AppNppDesc: Fast, lightweight and essential text editor to replace the default Notepad.
AppFdmDesc: Powerful download manager with HTTP/HTTPS file acceleration.
AppQbtDesc: Open-source BitTorrent client, extremely lightweight, free of ads, bloatware or unwanted bundled software.
AppSteamDesc: Digital game store and launcher by Valve.
AppEpicDesc: Epic Games digital store and launcher.
AppGogDesc: DRM-free digital game store and launcher.
AppSevenZipDesc: Free, open-source file archiver with a very high compression ratio.
AppWiztreeDesc: Extremely fast disk space analyzer, an alternative to WinDirStat.
AppMemreductDesc: Lightweight real-time RAM monitoring and cleaning utility.
AppBleachbitDesc: Free, open-source tool to clean disk clutter and protect privacy.
AppMoonlightDesc: Open-source game streaming client, used to connect to a Sunshine or NVIDIA GameStream host.
AppSunshineDesc: Self-hosted, open-source game stream host for Moonlight, with low-latency GPU-accelerated encoding.
AppNilesoftShellDesc: Powerful, highly customizable open-source context menu manager for File Explorer (MIT license).
AppOptiscalerClientDesc: Open-source desktop manager to install and update OptiScaler (DLSS/FSR/XeSS frame generation and upscaling injector) across your game library. Third-party GitHub project, not Microsoft-signed - review it before use.
AppFlowLauncherDesc: Fast, open-source keyboard launcher (Win key alternative) for apps, files, web search and plugins - a lighter, more extensible take on Windows Search / PowerToys Run.
AppShareXDesc: Free, open-source screenshot/screen-recording tool with built-in editing, annotation, GIF/video capture and one-click upload to dozens of destinations - a fuller-featured alternative to the built-in Snipping Tool.

TxtReleaseRenewDesc: Releases and renews the IP address on all network adapters (ipconfig /release + /renew).
TxtRegisterDNSDesc: Re-registers the DNS name and refreshes DHCP leases (ipconfig /registerdns).
TxtSystemInfoDesc: Shows CPU, RAM, GPU, OS version, disk type and battery health. Read-only, no changes are made.
TxtStartupManagerDesc: Lists programs that launch at sign-in from the Run registry keys and the Startup folder. Uncheck an item to disable it.
TxtScheduledOptDesc: Creates a scheduled task that runs the Basic optimization profile automatically on a daily or weekly basis.
LogSchedCreatedFail: Failed to create scheduled optimization task: {0}
TipRestoreDefaults: Restores registry and service defaults for the selected category.
TipCustomDays: Number of days between each automatic run (minimum 1).
LogSchedInvalidDays: Enter a whole number of 1 or more days for the custom schedule.
TipSelectAll: Toggles every checkbox on this tab at once; does not run anything by itself.
TipDryRun: Simulation mode: runs the same logic but only writes to the log, without touching the registry, services or files.
TipBloat: Uninstalls preinstalled UWP apps (Xbox, Bing apps, Copilot-related apps, etc.) via winget/Remove-AppxPackage.
TipSearch: Sets 'Windows Search' to search this device only, disabling cloud/Bing results in the Start Menu search.
TipVisual: Switches Performance Options to 'Adjust for best performance', disabling animations, shadows and transparency.
TipPrivacy: Sets registry policies that disable telemetry (AllowTelemetry=0), Windows Error Reporting, CEIP, Activity Feed and Location tracking.
TipDrivers: Sets the 'SearchOrderConfig' and Device Installation policy so Windows Update no longer installs drivers automatically.
TipPagefile: Disables automatic pagefile management and sets a fixed initial/maximum size equal to 1.5x installed RAM.
TipAdvertisingId: Sets HKCU AdvertisingInfo\Enabled to 0, stopping apps from using your per-user advertising ID.
TipTailoredExp: Disables 'Tailored experiences with diagnostic data' under Privacy > Diagnostics, stopping personalized tips based on usage.
TipDiagTrackSvc: Stops and disables the DiagTrack and dmwappushservice services, the main telemetry data-collection services.
TipCopilotBlock: Applies policies that block Copilot, Recall snapshots and Windows AI data analysis features.
TipInputTelemetry: Disables input personalization (handwriting/typing data collection) and clipboard history cloud sync.
TipEdgeWidgets: Disables Edge startup boost/preloading and removes the Widgets board from the taskbar via policy.
TipDeliveryOpt: Sets Delivery Optimization to LAN-only, stopping Windows from uploading update chunks to other PCs over the internet.
TipAppsBackground: Sets 'Let apps run in the background' to Off via policy, so most UWP apps only run while in the foreground.
TipNetworkLatency: Tunes TCP/IP registry parameters (ack frequency, Nagle-related delays) aimed at lower network latency.
TipHungAppTimeout: Reduces HungAppTimeout/WaitToKillAppTimeout registry values so frozen programs are detected and can be closed faster.
TipDisableSysMain: Stops and disables the SysMain (SuperFetch) service, which preloads apps into RAM; usually redundant on SSDs.
TipDisableWSearch: Stops and disables the WSearch service; frees CPU/disk I/O but Start Menu file search will stop working.
TipDisableSpooler: Stops and disables the Print Spooler service; only do this if no printer is connected to this PC.
TipWinSxSCleanup: Runs DISM /StartComponentCleanup to remove superseded Windows component versions from WinSxS and reclaim disk space.
TipDisableXboxServices: Stops and disables XblAuthManager, XblGameSave, XboxNetApiSvc and XboxGipSvc, the background Xbox account/save-sync services.
TipHibernation: Runs powercfg /hibernate off, removing hiberfil.sys and disabling Fast Startup along with it.
TipPowerPlan: Activates the built-in 'High performance' power plan instead of Balanced, preventing CPU frequency throttling.
TipTempCleanup: Deletes files from %TEMP%, the Prefetch folder, Windows.old and the SoftwareDistribution download cache.
TipHotCorners: Disables Snap Assist window-edge snapping and the Aero Shake minimize-others gesture.
TipBootTimeout: Runs bcdedit /timeout 5 to shorten how long the boot menu waits before starting Windows automatically.
TipOfficeTelemetry: Sets registry policies that disable Office diagnostic data collection and OneDrive usage telemetry.
TipExtraSchedTasks: Disables extra Microsoft telemetry scheduled tasks (Customer Experience Improvement Program, Consolidator, etc.).
TipDiskOptimize: Configures scheduled TRIM for SSDs or scheduled defragmentation for HDDs, detected automatically per drive.
TipHagsGameMode: Turns on Windows Game Mode and Hardware-accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS) in the registry.
TipUltimatePerf: Imports and activates the hidden 'Ultimate Performance' power plan and sets minimum CPU state to 100%.
TipKernelGamingPriority: Raises the GPU/CPU scheduling priority (kernel PriorityControl and MMCSS 'Games' task) for the foreground game.
TipGameDvrDisable: Disables Xbox Game DVR background recording (AppCaptureEnabled=0), freeing CPU/GPU/disk overhead.
TipGameBarMicFix: Disables Windows' microphone echo cancellation/noise suppression, which can otherwise cause robotic-sounding mic audio in the Game Bar overlay.
TipInputLagReduction: Disables mouse pointer acceleration, Sticky Keys prompts and per-app Fullscreen Optimizations to lower input latency.
TipSearchIndexOptimize: Excludes cache/temp/junk folders from the Windows Search index so indexing uses less disk and CPU.
TipGhostAdapters: Removes disconnected ('ghost') network adapters left behind in Device Manager by drivers or VPN software.
TipFastStartup: Turns off Fast Startup (hybrid shutdown), which can otherwise leave a stale hibernated kernel session that leaks RAM.
TipResidualServices: Sets low-impact services (PcaSvc, WerSvc, wisvc, RetailDemo) to Manual startup instead of Automatic.
TipStandbyListClean: Immediately purges the memory Standby List using the WGO native module, freeing cached RAM without a reboot.
TipLargeSystemCache: Enables the 'LargeSystemCache' registry setting for systems with 8GB+ RAM, favoring file cache over app memory.
TipAutoStandbyClean: Creates a scheduled task that clears the Standby List memory cache automatically every 5 minutes.
TipClearEventLogs: Runs wevtutil to clear all Windows Event Viewer logs (Application, System, Security, etc.).
TipClearStoreCache: Runs wsreset.exe to reset the Microsoft Store cache.
TipDisableCoreParking: Sets CPU core parking minimum to 0% in the active power plan so Windows keeps all cores active instead of parking idle ones.
TipDisableHPET: Runs bcdedit /deletevalue useplatformclock and disables the dynamic tick, removing the High Precision Event Timer as the time source.
TipTimerResolution: Applies a persistent Windows timer resolution of 0.5ms via the WGO native module instead of the default ~15.6ms.
TipIncreaseTdrNvidia: Raises the TdrDelay/TdrDdiDelay registry values so the GPU driver waits longer before a Timeout Detection and Recovery reset.
TipDisableNvidiaTelemetry: Stops NVIDIA Telemetry Container/services and disables the related NVIDIA scheduled tasks.
TipDisableNagle: Sets TcpAckFrequency=1 and TCPNoDelay=1 on every network interface, disabling Nagle's algorithm to reduce small-packet latency.
TipDisableIPv6: Sets DisabledComponents=0xFF in the registry, disabling IPv6 on every adapter.
TipRssOptimize: Enables Receive Side Scaling and tunes the number of RSS queues via netsh for better multi-core network throughput.
TipHostsBlock: Appends known Microsoft telemetry domains to the hosts file, blackholing them at the DNS/hosts level.
TipPrivacyDeep: Disables Shared Experiences (Nearby Sharing/handoff) and fully removes the legacy Cortana components.
TipCacheClean: Rebuilds the icon cache database and clears the font cache service files.
TipUiCleanup: Removes the People taskbar icon, the News and Interests widget and the Windows Ink Workspace via policy.
TipTcpAutotuning: Runs netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=disabled, using a fixed TCP receive window instead of an adaptive one.
TipDoH: Sets 1.1.1.1/1.0.0.1 (Cloudflare) as DNS servers and enables DNS-over-HTTPS for encrypted DNS lookups.
TipFastShutdown: Sets ClearPageFileAtShutdown=0, skipping the security wipe of the pagefile so shutdown finishes faster.
TipPrefetchSSD: Disables the Prefetch/Superfetch boot-file cache when an SSD is detected, since it offers no benefit on flash storage.
TipRemoveWinBackup: Hides the 'Windows Backup' promotional notifications; the app itself is a protected system component and cannot be uninstalled.
TipTcpIpReset: Runs netsh int ip reset and netsh winsock reset to rebuild the TCP/IP stack after connectivity issues.
TipRemoveOnedrive: Runs the OneDriveSetup uninstaller and removes leftover OneDrive folders, registry keys and Explorer integration.
TipDisableGameBar: Sets AppCaptureEnabled and GameDVR_Enabled to 0, disabling the Game Bar overlay and its Win+G shortcut.
TipDisableStore: Disables the Microsoft Store app via policy while keeping winget (App Installer) functional for command-line installs.
TipDisableWer: Sets Disabled=1 for Windows Error Reporting, stopping crash reports from being generated or sent.
TipPauseUpdates: Sets a PauseUpdatesExpiryTime 7 days in the future in the Windows Update policy keys.
TipDisableEdgeTelemetry: Sets Edge policies (MetricsReportingEnabled, diagnostic data) to 0, disabling Edge's own telemetry separately from Windows'.
TipDisableSpotlight: Disables Windows Spotlight lock-screen suggestions and 'Windows tips' via policy.
TipRiskyUAC: Sets EnableLUA=0, turning off User Account Control prompts entirely. Any program can then request admin rights silently.
TipRiskySmartScreen: Disables SmartScreen for both Windows apps and Microsoft Edge, removing the warning shown before running unrecognized files.
TipRiskyDefenderRT: Sets DisableRealtimeMonitoring=1 for Windows Defender, stopping real-time scanning of files as they are accessed.
TipRiskyWinUpdateSvc: Stops and disables the wuauserv service, preventing Windows from installing any updates until re-enabled.
TipRiskyBits: Stops and disables the BITS service, which many apps (including Windows Update) use for background downloads.
TipRiskyDisableFirewall: Turns off Windows Firewall for all network profiles (Domain/Private/Public), leaving the PC unprotected on any network.
TipRiskyDisableDEP: Runs bcdedit /set nx AlwaysOff, disabling Data Execution Prevention, a memory-exploit mitigation, system-wide.
TipRiskyNvidiaMaxPerf: Sets the NVIDIA Control Panel power management mode to 'Prefer maximum performance', disabling GPU clock down-throttling at idle.
TxtRestartPrompt: Optimization complete. Some changes only take full effect after a restart.
LogCoreParkingNoPlan: Core parking could not be adjusted on any power plan on this system.
LogHagsSkippedAmd: AMD GPU detected: Hardware-accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS) was skipped because it is known to cause crashes/instability on several AMD driver builds. Game Mode was still enabled.
LogPowerPlanReverted: The power plan change did not stick — another tool (e.g. ExitLag) or a Group Policy is forcing a different plan back after it's changed.
TxtAmdGpuBanner: No AMD Radeon GPU was detected on this system, so these fixes are disabled (they don't apply to NVIDIA or Intel graphics).
TxtAmdGpuBannerDetected: AMD Radeon GPU detected. These fixes target the most common causes of driver crashes, black screens and stutter.
TipAmdUlps: Sets EnableUlps=0 on every GPU driver instance, preventing the card from dropping into an unstable low-power state on multi-GPU or hybrid (laptop) setups.
TipAmdMpo: Sets DWM's OverlayTestMode=5, disabling Multi-Plane Overlay to fix flickering and black-screen issues in some games and apps.
TipAmdTdr: Sets TdrDelay/TdrDdiDelay to 10 seconds, giving the driver more time before Windows resets a GPU that seems unresponsive.
TipAmdCrashDefender: Stops and disables the AMD Crash Defender service, which can mask real GPU driver crashes behind automatic recovery instead of surfacing them.
TipAmdHdcp: Sets DAL2_DisableHDCP=1 on the AMD driver, preventing display disconnects and flicker with incompatible monitors or cables.
TipAmdTelemetry: Stops and disables the AMD External Events and AMD User Experience services, reducing background processes.
TipAmdHwAccel: Disables MPO, sets HAGS to disabled (HwSchMode=1) and forces Chrome/Edge to use OpenGL instead of ANGLE/Direct3D, fixing crashes and black screens in Electron apps like Discord and Spotify.
LogAmdUlpsOk: ULPS disabled on all AMD GPU driver entries.
LogAmdUlpsUnavailable: No AMD GPU driver entry with ULPS support was found.
LogAmdCrashDefenderUnavailable: AMD Crash Defender service not found on this system.
LogAmdHdcpOk: HDCP disabled on the AMD driver.
LogAmdHdcpUnavailable: No AMD driver instance with HDCP support was found.
LogAmdTelemetryUnavailable: No AMD telemetry service was found on this system.
